title: AudioCapabilities
description: Reproducible audio capability for the receiver v1-lite profile. Declares playable capacity, not the DAC's theoretical capacity. Standard and Hi-Fi initially announce the same certified audio; a new capability requires schema, vectors, engine, tests and physical evidence.

transports.description: Supported RTP transports. Exactly rtp_udp for v1-lite.

codecs.description: Supported codecs. Exactly pcm_s16le for v1-lite; no lossy codecs and no 24-bit PCM.

sample_rates.description: Supported sample rates in Hz. Exactly 48000 for v1-lite.

bit_depths.description: Supported bit depths. Exactly 16 for v1-lite.

channels.description: Supported channel counts. Exactly stereo (2) for v1-lite.

packet_ms.description: Supported RTP packet durations in milliseconds. Exactly 10 ms for v1-lite.

payload_types.description: Supported RTP payload types. Exactly 97 for v1-lite.

buffer_ms_min.description: Minimum accepted jitter buffer in milliseconds. Frozen at 50.

buffer_ms_max.description: Maximum accepted jitter buffer in milliseconds. Frozen at 500.
